purpose: Eulogy (stotra) composed in honor of Dvaipāyana Vyāsa to obtain prosperity for the author's father
notes: Pillar inscription containing a 34-stanza hymn to Dvaipāyana (Vyāsa). The date portion is missing/lost; paleographically assigned to the reign of Mānadeva I or Vasantadeva. The author's father is referred to anonymously (pitari me).
